# AAV, Segreteria di Stato, Francia 32, ff. 49v-54v: Filippo Sega, Paris, early January 1591, duplicate ("Dupp.ta"); enciphered part only (f. 49r is in clear).
# Transcribed from DECODE R5615 (views 2-12), https://de-crypt.org/decrypt-web/RecordsView/5615 ; images not included (DECODE terms: research use only).
# 88 blocks (B1-B88; the file for f. 50r holds B2 and B3), each transcribed and frozen (SHA-256) before it was decoded; transcription made with the key in mind (declared bias).
# Notation: digit pairs; a sign after a digit: ':' diaeresis (a), '^' circumflex (e), '-' bar (i), '+' cross (o); '.' dot (nomenclator, last digit dotted: 128. = Umena).
# delta-shaped 6 written 6. Code letters of Meister key 65 in lower case as in key.tsv (b che, c per, e come, l il, m lo, n la, u del, y delli...), with Z = non, X = della, P = quello.
# Symbols written in capitals: CON (two verticals on a base line), IN (omega), PIU (lone underlined sign), MA, GIA, GLI (barred 4), TANTO, QUESTI (triangle, also written as the
#   triangle sign itself), ACCIO; "(" = sign read as il (by sense). Signs not identified are kept as seen: the long s with a crook (6 times, always before a noun), and single
#   unusual marks (crossed looped stroke, triangle on a bar, barred f, and a few others). ? = doubtful sign. A pair split by the line end is written on the line where it starts.
# Line labels: block, folio, line on the page (a/b = enciphered segments of the same line, separated by clear text). Clear text not transcribed here (see reading.md).
